notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/292b14028e6938544d1900dcf9812f39123bba38.png

New Season

The new season has already begun! All players’ mines went to the bots and their levels dropped. Your task is to take them back, level them up, and defend them from other players’ attacks! And, when the season is over, the bravest and most courageous defenders will receive chevrons reflecting the valor they have shown on the battlefields

Battle Reward Changes 

We have made the process of obtaining high-level chests, such as legendary and mythic ones, Let’s scale new heights, Defenders! :) 
To find more information about the battle rewards, look for a dedicated post on our social media. 

New Heroes in the Castle

A squad of new Heroes has arrived at the Castle. They are determined to raise your level even higher. Give them a chance to prove themselves and they will not let you down! 

U’uk (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic monkey king designed to significantly increase the damage dealt to the underground Creeps in the Castle.
Troublemaker (and its foil counterpart) is an epic beast warrior hunting down the underground Creeps of legendary rarity and below. 
Fallen (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic knight whose mind has been consumed by the shadow. His specialization is to inflict fear on his enemies. 
Minstrel (and its foil counterpart) is an epic musician whose songs breathe a new life into and give them vivific energy totems. 
Dragon Warrior (and its foil counterpart) is an epic warrior who has spent years learning martial arts. People say that with one hit he can stun his opponent ‘til the end of their days. 

New Cards

Flying Shredder is a unique mythic tower one sight of which makes the Creeps shudder with fear. It is flying, and inflicts a Hemorrhage effect on the enemies that deals damage over time.

As usual, the new tower will be available in one of the following events. 

New Enemies

“The Primezone is bigger than we’ve thought,” concluded Primologist on his briefing with the Hero squad. He has cautiously warned the warriors about new Creeps that have been spotted on the east of the Primezone. 

Scatheless Spider is a small but capable enemy that cannot be poisoned. You have to find other ways to fight this pest :) 

Adamantine Goliath is an enemy with a nasty surprise: upon death, it releases a horde of Scatheless Spiders. Arachnophobes, beware!

New Totem

When nature itself makes you follow a completely different set of rules, druids call it silence. We present you a new Totem. 
Cancelling Totem prohibits the use of magic in a certain area around it. 

Fixes

- Fixed the bug with quests related to the Pumpkin Gun and Volcano towers that did not finish;
- Fixed the bug with Corruption crafting when the players might have received the wrong number of shards;
- Fixed the bug with the Crystal Teleport when the players could place the runes on them blocking the path for flying/underground enemies;
- Fixed the bug with Flicker not enhance Burning Roots;
- Fixed the bug with the Queen and Incandescent Core not dealing the correct amount of damage to the flying enemies;
- Fixed the bug with the Indestructible Idol not dealing the increased amount of damage to the Fleetles when they were underground;
- Fixed the bug with the foil Mermaid’s Tower not stunning the Fleetles when they were underground;
- Fixed the bug with enemies not receiving the stunning effect under the Magma spell.

Defenders! We want to please you with the announcement of a great change that will appear in the game in the next update.

New Season
New Season has already begun! All players’ mines went to the bots and their level dropped. Your task is to get the mines back, level them up, and defend them against other players’ attacks!
With introduction of the new resource mines we have added a new shevron that you can get for your rating achievements during the Season.

Look for more information in the related posts on our social networks ːsteamhappyː


New Heroes for the Castle
You heard the dull sound of the cartwheels. A carriage with another squad of new Heroes has arrived at the Castle. They are sprightly and ready to conquer new peaks. Hurry up and recruit the new warriors:

🔹Grenadier (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic professional shooter of the Damage group;
🔹Firemaster (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic fox mage of the Inflammation group;
🔹Tamer (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic warrior and tamer of the Against Flying group;

We are thrilled to see you taking control of the Prime Zone matter and using portals. That is why we are giving you more reasons to make the Teleportation a permanent card in your deck! Here for you:

🔹Techna is an epic Hero whose powers increase the chance and distance of the teleportation;
🔹Electra (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic Hero that not only increases the chance and distance of the teleportation but gives additional bonuses to the Towers and spells;

Meet Invincibug, a New Enemy
They say that when the Prime Zone was formed, this bug’s body absorbed an unimaginable amount of Prime, making its skin stronger than the toughest diamond.

The new enemy not only flies but is also completely immune to any poison. The bug's skin is so tough that the immunity to poison cannot be removed even by the Purifier or Tower of Order. Get ready to use all your ingenuity to fight back this monster!


A New Spell
A new spell is here! Corruption is a mythical spell that curses enemies in a similar way as the existing legendary card. However, for flying enemies, this card is much more dangerous, because this curse’s effect is 1.4 times stronger on them!
As usual, the card will be available in one of the following events.


Balance Changes ⚙️
⚙️ The Banshee Tower. Now, Banshee, as befits a harbinger of death, uses all her horror to instill fear in the Creeps. The Creeps' Fear Chance and Immunity base values ​​are now similar to other mythic Towers. Banshee still casts a curse, but this effect is secondary, and Tower upgrades now increase the duration and power of fear.

⚙️ The Volcano and Pumpkin Gun. We are making changes to the mechanics of inflicting damage by the "puddles" of these Towers, as in some cases they worked incorrectly.
Now, only one "puddle" from one Tower will inflict damage in each tile of the playing field. Several "puddles" from one Tower will inflict damage only if they are located in different areas of the playing field.
At the same time, several "puddles" from several towers will summarize their damage even at one area of the playing field.
Simply put, before the damage was bound to a "puddle", now, it is bound to the Tower. Therefore, it still makes sense to have as many Towers of this type as possible in order to maximize the overall damage.

Story Quests
We are happy to present you with completely revamped quests. There will be a series of story quests with some cool rewards for their completion!
By completing the quests, you can kill two birds with one stone: learn more about the world of Prime World: Defenders 2 and receive some valuable prizes, among which there are valuable resources, chests of up to mythical rarity, shadow shards, and much more! Well, what kind of story is it if it does not have a prologue? New players can now enjoy an amazing storyline comic at the start of the game. Our experienced Defenders are also not left behind: the comic is already available on all our social networks!


What’s New with the Castle?
While the Castle has been standing still and proud, its development has not. Meet new bonus levels where you can battle and receive foil card shards and other valuable prizes as a reward!

And what about new Heroes? Well, here they come! The catalysts' discovery helped summon a squad of new fighters, who will gladly join your team and help you in your fight for the Castle. They will also be useful for your daily affairs in the Prime Zone. You can meet them at the Castle's Trading area.


Teleportation: Introducing the New Game Mechanic.
Here and there in a blink of an eye! Meet a completely new game mechanic designed to make the gameplay even more immersive!

Before going into details, we would like to note that in the next game updates we will expand the line of such cards! Now let's welcome the first cards with the new mechanics:

Crystal Teleport is a legendary tower that moves the Creeps a few tiles back. Just like the stun/fear, the teleport has a chance to be triggered, and the Creeps gradually gain immunity to this effect.
Teleportation is a mythical spell that, at your command, will move the Creeps in the selected area to a farther distance.

Isn't it cool?

As usual, you will be able to get the new cards at one of the following events.

Burning Roots. The burning turned out to be not powerful enough, so we hastened to fix it. The tower now deals more damage and slows down the Creeps even more.

Flying Smasher. The card upgrades now increase the stun chance.
Moreover, now you can insert runes to increase the stun chance, and the Heroes who have the same effect will strengthen the tower. Not enough? Anomalies and Speed runes now increase the stone fire rate.

Snowball has undergone treatment similar to the Smasher. Card upgrades increase the chance of slowing down. You can also insert runes to increase the chance of slowing down, and Heroes who have the same effect will strengthen the tower. Anomalies and ​​Speed runes increase the snowball fire rate.

Tower of Order. Well, the name speaks for itself. Now, similar to the Purifier, it removes buffs (even immunities!) from the Creeps, but now it is an AREA effect! It no longer slows down the Creeps.
The foil version of this card further increases the duration of the silence effect.

Meteor. We have listened to your requests! From now on, runes for the main parameter increase the stun duration (we have not forgotten about battle improvements ).
THE CREEPS WILL NOT PASS.
The foil version of the card now additionally increases the stun duration!

Queen. This card was not a real match for its royal name in various game situations. We have made some changes to it, so now the card will become a welcome addition to your deck. Now, the tower increases damage to flying enemies by 4 times!


Improvements
➕ We are making some visual changes! We have updated the icon for the mythical chest. It now reflects the value and importance of this magnificent chest.
➕ Please note that from now on, after trying to impose the fear effect on Gnolls, Wolfhounds, and Magi, the slowing effects cease to act on them.

✔️ Fixed a bug with the icon "Blocking the path for underground enemies" not being displayed, when inserting a rune with this effect in the tower;
✔️ Fixed a bug with totems that deal damage, when, in some cases, they dealt a disproportionate amount of damage to the Creeps;

notes.title: Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/43a4abb6d600060cbd78f3696dbed88321881528.png


Defenders!

As you know, our game is actively developing and evolving. We are adding new functions and cards, reworking old mechanics. These changes are often global and may affect the entire game.
At the same time, some functions become less relevant and do not correspond to the current situation in the Prime Zone anymore.

That is why we have revised a number of game aspects in the version 1.9.7 to make them match better with the game’s complexity and fun.

1. Difficult Level Changes. 
Let us remind you that Difficult level is a more difficult battle on the same map, with already built and / or upgraded towers, which you can try to clear if the current battle is completed with the maximum number of hearts. Clearing a certain number of difficult levels increases the rewards value that you will receive after the battle.

Along with the introduction of a new mine system, we have also improved the Difficult levels system. However, we have not introduced them immediately, along with the test launch of the mines.

⚙️  Previously, the number of Difficult levels available for clearing increased very slowly, opening completely (up to 20) only at level 60 of your account.
This late availability hindered low and intermediate level players, especially when they started to fight for the mines.

Now, the maximum number of Difficult levels is available for clearing as soon as you reach level 35 of your account. Accordingly, players of lower levels will be able to fight the Creeps for bigger rewards, and with other players for high-level mines.

⚙️  The difficulty increase was non-linear: at first it increased slightly, and the main increase occurred already towards the high levels. This situation led to the situation when some battles, especially the ones in the mines, did not pose a real challenge to the player and did not reflect well the competitive aspect of the game.
Therefore, we have changed the formula for increasing difficulty: now it rises faster, which makes Difficult levels (especially in the PvP mode) more interesting, and battles more intense. At the same time, the maximum level is still the same, 20, i.e. maximum difficulty has not changed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a62ea74cf3cf994d44714e4c726c408bd6c7fcbe.png


⚙️  Also, getting the improved battle reward, especially in the highest level mines, was easy. Before, when the fight in a high-level mine was time-limited, it was justified. However, in the new system, the reward distribution has become incorrect.
At the same time, the absence of a reward for completing the maximum level 20 for players with a Premium raised some questions.

And along with the end of the new resource mine system test period, we have made the planned changes to the rewards. Now the improved reward demands the higher number of Difficult levels cleared.
And premium account owners can compete for an additional reward, which becomes available after passing the most difficult level 20!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/76eb13d86a60929edca8b75dbd1ec3f46dd6a71a.png


We have also revised the rarity of cards received as a battle reward, relative to the point level (PvE or PvP battles). Now its rise is smoother.

2. Changes in the cost of starting a battle on PvP and PvE locations.
Taking into account the fact that players now always receive resources without any downtime caused by inability to capture the mine and / or the change unavailability of changing the opponent, the cost of starting a battle has been revised.
We did not make these changes during the new mine system test launch, and we are adding it now, along with some improvements, at the start of the new season.

Now the cost of starting a battle is:

⚪️  In regular PvE missions - from 110 to 1,505 Silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In epic PvE missions - from 110 to 5,000 silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In legendary PvE missions - from 110 to 10,015 silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In resource mines - the cost of launching depends on the mine level.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8db950b1f48c800227f628c5eff6674041b7f017.png


Of course, when dealing with resource mines we did not ignore their league counterparts. Now, players can find Shadow shards for crafting and leveling up the necessary cards in the chests they get for the league competition!

3. Changes in the cost of mythical cards crafting and level-up.
Taking into account the fact that with the new resource mines system the process of obtaining Red Crystals from the Red Chests has become much more controllable, we have adjusted the cost of creating and leveling up the most valuable towers in the game — mythical ones.
Besides, Red Crystals had been losing their relevance as a valuable resource necessary to obtain and upgrade the "red" content which also led to misunderstanding among the players.
Now Red Crystals will become much more understandable and valuable for all players: both those who have recently reached level 90, and those who have already settled at the top of the game!

Now the cost is:

♦️  2 Red Crystals for creating 1 shard of a mythic tower card or spell
♦️  1,500 Red Crystals for the evolution of a tower, spell, or Hero card.

4. In-game Store.
Also, we have made some improvements to the in-game store in this update.
The Random tab has been renamed to Fair and got a new icon that reflects its essence better!
Besides, we have significantly expanded and updated the assortment in this tab, so it would be interesting to players of all levels. We have also updated some of the offers in the Calendar tab. You can now find Shadow shards and essences among them.

See you in the Prime Zone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4d157efc137615ee28dfca0b3a5b704254930cc7.png

Defenders!

We continue telling you about the planned in-game changes. And today it is time to discuss the most mysterious and exciting thing for the players — crafting system.
And not only about that ːsteamhappyː

Chests Update

Before getting to the most important part of the announcement, let's talk about something we have planned as the next step after the Hero rebalance and will introduce into the game with the next update — the update of chest contents.

First of all, we would like to note that the current system of getting Heroes is confusing, incomprehensible, and often tiresome. Sometimes a significant amount of card shards, time, and even essences is required to receive a golden chest. It is noticeably out of line if we take the process of getting the rest of the cards in the game into consideration and make the process of farming Heroes too long and complicated.

Therefore, we decided to give up the Hero chests and add Hero cards, just like tokens, to the regular chests that you receive for winning on the location.

The rarity of Heroes and tokens, dropping from the chests, will be determined according to the current system, which means the whole process of getting Heroes will become much easier, including those of the legendary rarity ːsteamhappyː
And, of course, you no longer have to spend tokens on Hero chests because you will only need them for evolution.

Thus, getting all types of cards — Towers, Spells, Heroes — will become more transparent, uniform, and affordable. The need to level-up and sell cards will become a thing of the past. The reason for this is the fact that unnecessary card shards will now be used to a greater extent to level-up and create the cards that you need.

Red Chests

Of course, we cannot help but take care of the highest-level chests in the game, the mythic ones.
First, getting such chests is pretty much tied to the players' activity now, and that is something they cannot control (to an extent).
Second, unlike the other chests, you cannot receive runes from mythic ones, and when you are at a high level, a lot often depends on how well the runes are upgraded and how many bonuses they give.
And as a whole, these chests are not in line with the general system, and sometimes it confuses players who have just reached level 90.

With this in mind, we are planning to do the following:
 Add mythic chests to the battle rewards (both in PvP and PvE locations);
 Bring their content to a unified form — apart from card shards, there will be silver, resources, and runes.
It means that level 90 players will be able to receive mythic chests more often, and collecting runes of high rarity will become easier. After all, legendary runes will be in the red chests! And also valuable runes with a double effect 😃

At the same time, red chests will remain at the store, and you can buy them for both Red Crystals and Stars.

Crafting System for Tower, Spell, and Hero Cards

We decided to introduce the crafting system with what constitutes the basis of the game — Tower, Spell, and Hero cards.

At the moment, it can be quite difficult to get the right Tower, even with the fact that the card shards are a part of the battle reward, can be found in random stores, and are available for viewing ads.
We want to make the process of getting cards that the player needs more understandable and controllable. For this purpose, we are introducing the crafting system into the game.

It will work as follows:
 You can choose a card or card shard from those available in the collection to create a new card;
 There will be a special button in the card menu that will take you directly to the crafting interface;
 There, you can choose which cards from the inventory you would like to convert to the ones you have selected at the first stage.

Besides, by doing this, you get a chance of receiving a bonus — shards of card's foil analog or other special cards.

Thus, you will have full control of getting the cards you need and/or their duplicates (to increase the Quantity parameter, for example). And, as a bonus, receive foil counterparts of your favorite cards :)

Runes crafting will work on a similar principle (except for the foil counterparts, of course), but will be brought to the game a bit later.

We are also preparing a considerable amount of foil Heroes, new Heroes, and other changes that will make the game more engaging and fun 😃

notes.title: Announcement of Global Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/57c20e36adc76615b549a704c3e74223252c5713.png

Defenders!

Today we would like to tell you about a global rebalance that is planned for the coming Off-Season.
The changes are really big — more variety will appear in the game along with them. Lots of abuses and tactics for completing any mission or mine with a combination of cards for damage + fear or damage + stun will become a thing of the past. Even players write in the comments and game chat that they are bored with the system of two or three towers — and in general this situation is not in line with the strategic genre of Tower Defense.

In addition, we are planning changes that will make the combat system much clearer for all players — for those who have joined us recently as well as for those who have already achieved a lot.

At once we will notice that any balance corrections (if they are not about obvious bugs) we are planning to introduce now and in the future, will happen only Off-Season. The reason for this is the fact that players are not ready for balance changes during intense confrontations over mines — and we respect this dedication and do not want to interfere with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/cb271998cddb6480f58392b426c06ca9d42315b5.png
The process of upgrading towers in battle works in a rather complex way — some towers get increased damage, others get increased range, etc. This system, in our opinion, is not good enough for the following reasons:
- Players do not have a clear understanding of what will happen in a battle when they upgrade a particular tower. This is especially true for new (just received) towers. A hint given to the player when they choose a rune is not always noticeable and understandable.
- In battle, some towers at a certain point ceased to increase their effectiveness with further upgrades.
- Also, this system did not work well with a number of tactics for completing missions.

As part of global rebalance, we want to bring the following to the system:
- Upgrading the tower in battle will only increase the main impact parameter. For damage towers this is damage, the strength of the buffs or debuffs for support towers and the chance of triggering for counter towers.

Here are some examples:
- Now if you upgrade the Accursed Bastion in the battle, it will increase the duration of the curse on the enemy. After the rebalance, upgrading this tower in battle will increase the main impact parameter of the tower — % of damage to the creeps.
- Upgrading the Horrifying Tower now increases its range. After the rebalance, it will increase the chance to make the enemy flee in fear.

Such a change will make battles more interesting, give the player more control over the effective use (and upgrades) of the towers and, of course, make it more simple to understand the result of a tower upgrade in battle.

As for spells, we want them to be more effective at the start of the battle.
- So, spells will get all the improvements (that they receive from runes) at the start of the mission, instead of receiving one star at the beginning of each difficult level.

This change will allow players to have more micro-control at the beginning of any mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f872707903d86b97bcb3be267e7b5da04eb65029.png
We continue to work on game effects — to leave out all abusive schemes, diversify the number of tactics and make the way effects work clearer for the players.

Now slowdown works the best (if you do not count the abuses) — it is interesting to play with, can be used in battle with great effectiveness, but at the same time, with rare exceptions, it does not simplify the flow of battle drastically.

Therefore, we decided to use the same mechanics with all effects: parameters that add up.
However, we believe that a more interesting way is to sum up effects from different sources.

Here is an example:
After the rebalance, effects of the curse will be added up. This means that a 20% increase in damage from the Accursed Bastion, 20% of the Spider's Nest and 20% of the Curse will add up and give a 60% increase in damage to the creeps.
At the same time, 20% of one Accursed Bastion and 20% of another Accursed Bastion will not add up.

The same mechanics apply to effects that cause damage over time — a variety of poisons, puddles of lava, etc.
This means that the damage of puddles from two Volcanoes will not add up, i.e. it is no longer possible to lock up the creeps with fear or stun at the location entrance and bombard them with puddles from Volcano.
At the same time, damage from the Hornet Hive and, for example, the Snake Tower will add up since these are two different sources — two different towers.

This change in mechanics of the effects will improve the situation with monotonous tactics for completing missions and at the same time make the system simple and understandable because all effects will work according to one simple scheme.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/05aff7855cb489bd66fd686c96ed36ba7e3c23da.png
Another change that we would like to tell you about is the change in effectiveness of cards depending on their base rarity.
Now, almost all cards with the same number of stars (without influence of heroes and runes) have equal effectiveness — damage, range, rate of fire, etc.

We believe that this is not fully logical because the rarer a card is, the higher its effectiveness should be.
Therefore, as a part of the global rebalance, we revised parameters of the cards in such a way that now a card of higher rarity is guaranteed to be better than its less rare counterpart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f7f0bcba9594fb2e6e52bb34085fb4565f57a009.png
We are also planning to give the range of towers a specific system, so they are better suited for balanced use and maximum efficiency.

1. Short range. Towers in this group:
- Deal area damage.
- Buff allied towers with an aura.
- Weaken the creeps for some time (for example, with curse or slowdown);
2. Medium range. Towers of this group:
- Deal damage to one target (with a high rate of fire, but small damage per hit).
- Weaken monsters with auras that spread debuffs.
- Have control effects (landing, stunning, etc.).
- Deal damage over time to one target (for example, with poison).
3. Long range. This group of towers:
- Deal damage to one target (with a low rate of fire, but high damage per hit).
- Create areas on land that deal damage over time (Volcano, Pumpkin Gun).
- Dealing area damage on hit (Mortars).




These are the main comprehensive changes that we wanted to tell you about in advance.

Of course, these are not the only changes that we have made. We also revised parameters of many cards: significantly increased damage of the towers attacking one target; increased range for flying towers; revamped the intensity of applied effects for many towers.
The gameplay will cease to be straightforward, and card deck selection trivial.
Should you maximize the poisoning effect or distribute your resources into slowdown and curse? What is the best way to arrange towers for their maximum efficiency?
Also, these changes will bring back many cards that often remain in collections just to “check the box” or for sale. The situation that both we and the players who lovingly collected and upgraded many cards would like to avoid.

We would like to note right away that our work on the game balance does not end with these changes. We will continue to monitor what is going on in the game and how different towers and spells are used in various cases.

notes.title: Time of Changes
notes.notes:

Defenders! 

While having a friendly chat on board of a ship Chronicle learned that you urgently needed to get special towers. Previously their shards rarely appeared in Primezone, but they all have ended up in the hands of collectors who don’t want to give up such prized possessions. 

Willing to help you, Chronicle has found a way to do so. She’s ready to build a time machine which will take you to the past and will let you find the desired shards. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/dd0c13ec0aaf6dd80679eaa4c8afab87b0094e4e.png

Before you go on a hunt for Mechanisms, we want to inform you that this event is organized according to the NEW RULES!

We always listen carefully to what our community has to say and we see that not everyone likes the system of receiving event currency through tasks. Some players view it as a mundane job, and as a result, they enjoy the game less. And it makes us sad :( We also know that some players, especially those who are new to the game and those at the middle level, would like essences not to disappear from the rewards in the tasks during events. 

To make it more convenient for you, we have changed the principles of event-currency dropping from different sources, by shifting the focus from passive earning through tasks and chests on the map to active one — directly through battles! Previously the amount of event currency given for victory was minute. But now, every battle is worth a triumphant victory:
 The amount of event currency for all battles — of any difficulty level — has been increased by 12.5 times! Now, for every victory you will get 25 event currency units instead of 2. 
 By shifting the focus to event currency for battles, we have decreased its amount in chests — from 125 to 50 units. 
 Also, we have completely removed event currency from the tasks, so that players have a chance to earn additional essences during events.
 
We want to remind you that Premium doubles the amount of event currency received both for battles and chests. Players with Premium subscription will:
 Receive 50 event currency units for every victory! 
 Find 100 event currency units in chests!

The new system lets you participate in battles the way you want and gives you an opportunity to receive essences for completing the tasks :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/17a67d26c8001e4a8a0dec99682ba7364b943f8a.png

Now, let’s talk about the details of the events and rewards you get for them :) 

This time there are three events for players of 15-59, 60-89, and 90 levels. 

During the events players of all levels can get rare event towers — Incombustible Blackthorn, Mermaid’s Tower, Indestructible Idol, Tornado Generator, Incandescent Core, Sniper Rifle, and Flying Spray. Also, as a reward you can get several days of Premium, various runes — including the cyan ones, and all types of essences and Hero tokens. 

Exclusively for 15-89 level players we’ve added guaranteed rewards of rare flying towers — Flying Prime Arrester and Sky Eye. 

During the events players of level 90 can win valuable red crystals, and for the maximum number of spins they will get the grand-prize — Mythic All-Purpose Gear! 

Please note that if during the events you upgrade your account from level 59 to 60, or from level 89 to 90, then the number of spins and Mechanisms will be reset. All current rewards will be saved and you will be able to take part in another event with even cooler rewards! Moreover, in such cases, to make your start in a new event easier, you can contact our tech support and we will send you several Mechanisms as a compensation :) 
Apart from the tasks and increased amount of currency for victories in battles, the mechanics of the events has not changed. Collect Mechanisms, spin the wheel, and receive valuable gifts. The more you spin, the more valuable your rewards get! 

You can collect Mechanisms using: 
In-game methods (get twice as many Mechanisms by activating Premium):
 winning in battles; 
 opening chests located on the map.
 
Other methods:
 watching ads on mobile devices; 
 purchasing with stars (3000 Mechanisms for 100 stars!).
 
Events will last until June 15, but take note that:
 Starting from 11:59 p.m. UTC June 14, you will no longer be able to collect Mechanisms. Mechanisms you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours. 
 Until 11:59 p.m. UTC June 15, you will be able to use remaining Mechanisms to spin the wheel. 
 After that, Mechanisms will disappear from your account.
 
Let’s get those collectible towers!

As for feeders, All-Purpose Gears and Blessed Hammers are moved to the Towers tab, and Spell Amplifiers and Ice Emblems, to the Spells tab. Feeders are located right after the cards (before card shards).

We've also added some new runes for towers and spells! Equip them to discover new exciting tactics to fight creeps and create more effective builds. For example, there are new more relevant runes for support cards in the second slot (not just damage-boosting).

You may notice some locked options: Craft, Break, and Evolve. It's a small teaser to future updates 

To ease the collection process for you, with this update we are launching a themed event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ace3f2979a72e5c4cbab05f099e4925cd4c02e15.png
Prices for rare, epic, and legendary chests became 5–6 times lower:

• 10 rare chests—50 stars instead of 225!
• 10 epic chests—100 stars instead of 450!
• 10 legendary chests—150 stars instead of 900!

This isn't a temporal event — from now on, you'll always buy chests at extremely favorable prices!

Please note that:
• chests are no longer sold by the piece;
• bonuses for a one-time purchase of 10-chest boosters were removed;
• in the mobile version, you can still get rare chests by the piece for watching ads.

Moreover, the star-for-silver exchange became 10 times more profitable! The exchange rate is 1000 Silver for 1 Star (instead of 100 Silver). Yet, prices in Silver remain the same!

Premium will now grant one more useful bonus—a possibility to get a double reward in leagues.

Rune prices in daily and weekly offers became up to 17 times lower!

• Daily offers now contain 14 rare runes instead of 3, and the booster costs half the previous price (9 times more profitable)!
• Weekly offers now have 14 epic runes instead of 2, while the total price of the booster is 2.5 times lower (17 times more profitable)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1188655d83089f85fd1526ce9f1b423f6b9d079b.png
We noticed that the system of seasons was received with great enthusiasm! Players are fighting for the prize-winning places in ratings with renewed vigor. Since PvP became a greater part of Defenders 2, we decided to make it more convenient. To do so, we reworked and improved the mine menus—both resource and league. But there are more nice changes 

League Mines
The circle in the Mines tab of the league menu is now of the same color as the area you entered (red, blue, or green). This will make it easier to monitor your place in every single mine.

Also, the league PvP icon (the cup on the global map) now shows a certain number. It corresponds to the number of mines where you currently occupy the red area.

And in the new Season you will be recieving runes for your league rating everyday! To enter the league rating you’ll only have to open at least one league mine.

Follow the news :)

Resource Mines
The menu of the resource mines became much clearer. It has the following tabs:
• Mines: the tab works just like the button of the same name in leagues. Here you can see the list of all available resource mines and quickly go to the one you need.
• Rating: a usual tab with the world PvP rating. Local ratings are no longer displayed since they lost their relevance due to VPN use. We removed the friends' ratings too. Earlier we mentioned that we want to reconsider the system of social interaction. Our goal is to unbind the in-game friendship from social media. Large-scale changes will come in the future. Right now we are just gradually preparing for them.
• Rewards: a familiar tab with daily rewards that used to be in the Quests tab. We moved it to the mine menu so that everything could be in one place. Much more convenient this way 

The PvP icon (two crossed swords on the global map) now also displays the number of mines, captured by other players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/202c1ac66c066cca5d9a7ac2545b1af99b87279b.png
We continue to fight with abusing mechanics, including the circling-creeps-strategy that players complain about. The fixes were partially introduced in one of the previous updates. Today we introduce the second part.

Here come the reworked mechanics of stun, slow, and confusion!

Stun
Creeps can now stack stun resistance. If you stun creeps with any tower or spell, they get bonus resistance to the effect, stacking up to complete immunity. This will prevent situations when monsters could stay stunned forever.

Let's have a look at an example. Say, we take Stun Tower. Its card now has two characteristics: basic stun chance (for instance, 35%) and creeps' resistance to stun (3%). If the tower stuns a monster, the chance will drop to 32%; after that, to 29% and so on. At some point, creeps will become completely immune to the effect. Moreover, resistance from different sources can stack too.

Naturally, while working on these changes, we also reconsidered the stun chance for corresponding towers and spells.

Slow
Slow is now calculated differently too. Previously, slow % was subtracted directly from the creeps' speed. The maximum possible slow was 90% and only the strongest slow effect could be applied to creeps.

Now, the final speed is calculated according to the following formula: 100/(100 + Х). If a card reduces creeps' speed by 50 points, then: 100/(100+50) = 10/15, meaning the speed will be about 66% of the basic speed.

At the same time, effects from different sources can stack while the maximum slow remains the same—10x (when reduced by 900 points).

Fear
We reconsidered the confuse mechanics. Now it's called fear/flee. When feared, creeps no longer get confused at turnings. Instead, they flee in another direction. On narrow roads, creeps will turn back; on wide arenas, they may also turn sideways. The total distance they travel depends on the effect duration. When feared, creeps gain bonus fear resistance that works just like the stun resistance.

We also reconsidered the fear chance of towers while working on the update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/85d68852614d457bbf3f20dc5a06f66adfcf7b97.png
We improved several cards to make them more relevant.

Indestructible Idol now deals 4x damage to underground creeps in comparison to ground creeps.

Moreover, we increased the maximum effectiveness of the following Heroes: Da'Ka, Lightning Master, Aviator, Maiden, Mimi, Dryad, Cryo, Shadow, Fire Fox, Tearaway, Vryl, Cannoneer, Archer, S.Putnik, and Stalker. These Heroes now grant a higher bonus when upgraded to the maximum.

The Night Queen no longer removes disasters, but adds anomalies to the battle map.

The ability to re-complete missions with an active Duelist now has a certain chance of triggering. The chance value depends both on the complexity of the mission and on the level of Hero upgrade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8e24a10cf5476531d0eb8dd022b82203ed5ab24c.png
We prepared some more useful changes for the game interface!

The home screen now has a new button—To Battle! It shows the number of active PvE arenas. Press it to advance to a randomly selected location, available for attack. This button will enable a much easier battle search on the global map.

It's now possible for several icons to be displayed next to a player's nickname in the chat. This way, players will see your achievements—both in the classic and league PvP!

Additionally, we moved the settings back to the global map. New players will now have less trouble finding it 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png
Naturally, we introduced several fixes into the game too:

• Tower of Chaos will attack creeps if there are totems within its range.
• Colony of bats no longer stops attacking creeps for no apparent reason.
• Indestructible Idol no longer attacks flying and invisible creeps but can deal damage to totems.
• Incombustible Blackthorn now correctly increases the slow strength as it levels up.
• Number of runes refreshes automatically after the merging.
• Mythic content is no longer displayed among the legendary chest possible content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/c69c9f757bb6c9e3320e6dd46d3156d8acb6182b.png

We are introducing the long-awaited system of seasons to Defenders 2! Take part in battles, fight your way up the leaderboard, and earn unique rewards: only 100 best players will receive special prizes! PvP rating will reset as the seasons start, meaning everybody will stand a chance to win!

Season rewards feature chevron cards that can be equipped in the slots for Heroes. These cards will grant special titles, visible to everybody in the chat, to the best players in the PvP competition! The season rewards will also give special bonuses to their owners.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b0615ab31a076ce1b73e5fe7d4573c4748246ab0.png

We considerably reworked the league system.

Areas were changed: the red area is now intended for players with no victories, the blue, for players with at least one victory, and the green is for the best three players. Besides, rewards for the blue area were improved while less active players will find only 1 Silver in red chests.

To enter the next league, apart from getting into the green area, a player now also has to win a certain number of times. The change will prevent situations when participants accidentally got into too difficult leagues.

Moreover, the league can no longer drop and each mine has the highest possible league.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d450cfb8ea6200425689046cf067a70bd2c7f406.png

Having high-level players in mind, we are introducing the new league — Mythic League! Its rewards completely correspond to its status and name. Here you can earn valuable red crystals that can be exchanged for chests with mythic content in the shop.

Besides, Mythic League is not level-limited. Players below level 70 can enter it too! They just need to fulfill certain conditions.

Mythic League also has its own PvP rating that is determined by a player's position in all competitions together.

Learn more about the seasons, new league system, and Mythic League in this announcement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/c3f0535c19dc9022262b56987284177ca2fbe91f.png

We are announcing a course, set for a fight with abusing mechanics that destroy the desire to think over various combinations and strategies. This patch, we are adding two changes into the game.

We have reworked Ship Crane. From now on, HP of the base will always restore by 1❤ per minute and the number of additional lives will be limited: 1–5❤ per battle, depending on the Ship Crane upgrade. Because of this change, the annoying strategy of making the creeps circle round the battlefield will become considerably harder to perform. This is our first step towards a complete solution to this problem.

The Help me function (help from friends) was giving an unfair advantage to some players, allowing them to farm a variety of valuable rewards, which was damaging the in-game balance. As we introduce the system of seasons and rating reset, we want to remove such abuses and let all the players fight on equal terms, whether they have Facebook accounts or not. That is why we disabled the Help me function this patch. Right now we are reconsidering the system of social interactions. Our goal is to unbind the friends' bonuses from social networks.

As a part of balance changes, we reduced the number of available simultaneous battles on the map. Now, up to nine arenas can be available on default: three Assaults, three Hunts, and three Raids. Each mode has common, epic, and legendary difficulty. As before, timers appear on the map when a player wins arena battles. There can be nine of them too and they are selected as described above.

At the same time, we increased the highest upgrade level of Aeronautics from 6 to 10. This way, when the skill is fully upgraded, the number of available arenas (timers) is increased to 18.

Besides, since Duelist became much stronger in the new conditions, he is temporarily unavailable to get in Hero Packs or through level up. We are planning to rebalance the Hero and bring him back into the ranks later. Duelist will still be a part of your collection and grant the same effect if you already have the Hero card.

The effects of Beautification and Warlord were swapped. Now Beautification grants bonus experience when fusing any cards while Warlord affects Hero cards only.

Ship changes mentioned above are not the only ones. Now, all the upgrades are divided into four groups: common, special, rare, and epic. The higher the group, the more expensive the upgrade and the more time it takes to build it. Also, different upgrade groups become available at different account levels.

League rewards got rebalanced too. We revised the number of keys in green league chests: Stone and Bronze leagues now have 1 key each, Silver and Gold have 1-2, and Legendary and Mythic grant 1-3 keys. Blue chests always contain 1 key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/52980ba60fe8caf0ede3f6491bdce55f9cab89cb.png

Mythic chests in the shop are now available from level 90. From the very beginning, our goal was to create a new "red" type of content for high-level players who have already collected all the cards — so they could experience interesting fresh combos and new tactical horizons. However, — judging by our statistics and your feedback — mythic content has led to an issue: even legendary cards are getting irrelevant too fast and builds are no longer diverse. To fix this situation, we are making mythic content available at higher levels. Note: players of levels 70–89 who already have red cards won't lose anything. At the same time, they won't be able to get new mythic content from chests and events until they reach level 90.

We continue to work on the Defenders 2 interface to make the game more convenient for you, so this update brings some other pleasant changes to the shop!

Let's start with the most pleasant one  We fixed a bug, allowing players to get an unlimited number of stars for ads, so the Free Stars option is back in the shop in the mobile version of the game!

For your convenience, we moved the daily, weekly, and special offers to the main shop. Now, if you click the calendar icon on the global map, it will summon the list of rewards for entering the game.

Here is another small QoL change: we replaced packs with 4000, 8500 and 23,000 Silver by packs with 1000, 10,000 and 100,000 Silver. With such clear numbers, it will be much easier to do calculations in the head (in case you decide to buy several packs at a time). Yet, the exchange rate of Silver against Stars is the same: 1 Star = 100 Silver.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ba29d1b60aa4dcaba68693f31b45e8b374af78a2.png

The shop interface was not the only interface improvement! The notification on the ship icon now shows only the number of currently available upgrades.

Also, the buttons of the ship and league battles are swapped. You can now see your season rating near the button of league battles.

The following change was made at your requests: the Skip animation option now applies to Hero Packs too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png

Naturally, we introduced several fixes into the game too:
 Swift Rune properly works on Stun Tower and Mermaid's Tower.
 A player gets back to the global map when the progress is restarted.
 Damage over time (DOT) now gets calculated correctly for the Poisonous Swamp spell.
 Fixed the description of Vixen and Premium account.

notes.title: FAQ: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/07a7dbe6c8d674a68fcaa7aed15bc0ec4a4a025c.png

Defenders!
 
In mid-March, we talked in detail about forthcoming changes in the PvP system. We told you about the approaching seasons and updated leagues as well as introduced the new one — Mythic League.
 
We are genuinely glad that you are so interested in the announcement and have been discussing it a lot. Naturally, you had many questions. We did our best to answer them in the comment section as detailed as possible. There were quite a number of messages on different platforms (VK, Facebook, Steam). Some players might have missed something, so we decided to make up the unified FAQ.
 
Now, you can find all the needed information in one place :)
 
There go frequently asked questions about the update and our answers to them!
 
What will happen to high-level mines after the season starts?
 
When the season starts, all players' ratings will reset and the mines they posses will go to bots. The level of such a mine will be approximately the same as the player's level. You can read more about the PvP rating calculation here.
What will happen to my current leagues after the season starts? Will I have to do everything from scratch?
 
As the seasons begin, only league ratings will reset. The rest of your progress will be saved. If you have already reached high leagues in mines, you'll still be there after the update. At the same time, the maximum possible league in all the mines will be Mythic League.
 
It's important to note that league demotion won't happen anymore. If you reach a certain league in a particular mine, you'll be there — now and in the future seasons :)
Will I be able to participate in league PvP right after the update?
 
League PvP rating will be available only in Mythic League. In other words, before competing in league PvP, you'll have to reach Mythic League first at least in one mine. 
If all mines get reset, will everybody suddenly have smaller resource inflow?
 
We will introduce a complex change to the economic balance in the upcoming update, so we cannot consider the economic tweaks only with respect to the mines. Yes, players will have to fight for resources once again. At first, the inflow of essences and silver may indeed decrease. Yet, at the same time, we will improve the league rewards — in both "blue area" (since now such players will get rewards too) and new Mythic League that will let you earn valuable red crystals. Moreover, stars for watching ads will be back ;)
If it becomes more difficult to obtain resources, what will happen to gold helmets? They are already hard to get but if the mine inflow reduces, there'll be a real shortage.
 
Players will be able to receive gold tokens even for reaching the "blue area" so they will become easier to obtain. Blue chests can contain from 1 to 3 gold tokens and green chests, up to 9 (depending on the league).
You mentioned some Hero changes. What are you planning to change?
 
Yes, we are planning to reconsider the Hero system but for now, it's only an internal discussion of possible best options. We understand that many of you are interested in the question but we are not ready to answer right now — we are still searching for optimal decisions. What we know for sure is that everything will be the same in the short term.
Taking into account the new conditions, will the tower power have the decisive role in reaching the PvP top list? That being said, will the players who managed to get cyan runes have a significant advantage?
 
Remember that Defenders 2 is not only a tower defense but a collectible card game too. In CCGs, PvP tests not only your skill — it tests your collection. Players should win games thanks to their efforts (which includes getting an impressive collection), not abusing strategies.
 
Another thing is that season PvP rewards are there to highlight the status in the first place. If a player spent enough effort and time to get a great collection and then managed to enter the top 100 list, that player does deserve a special title in the chat.
 
Moreover, we'll keep an eye on the course of the first season as well as your feedback. If needed, we are ready to adjust the PvP rules accordingly.
Some players will receive their PvP rewards at the beginning of the first season. These rewards will give their towers additional damage. Does it mean they will have an advantage too?
 
As mentioned above, season rewards are mostly a sign of status. Yes, they do give a certain bonus to damage but it's not that huge, so current 100 top players won't get a significant advantage over others.
Why do you think the Ship Crane change will solve the problem with abuse? Doesn't it mean it will still be there but players will have to spend several hours instead of 10–15 minutes to perform it?
 
Shop Crane changes are just the first step towards a complete solution. This change will significantly complicate the mechanics and we do hope there won't be a lot of players ready to spend hours on a single battle. Additionally, we are working on other balance changes to stop this and other abusing strategies once and for all.
Are you going to keep the daily PvP rewards?
 
Yes, daily PvP rewards will remain.
Will the swap mine mechanics change?
 
In this update, we are not planning to change PvP mechanics in resource mines. Your opponents will be selected in the same way.
 Is it possible to be on the top of both PvP modes?
 
It is hard but possible in theory. Time will tell ;)
 
We remind that the first season is a test season in many respects and the rules might change in the future.
How many red crystals will be given in Mythic League?
 
Blue chests will contain 15 red crystals. To get them, you'll need to complete just one battle during the competition (that lasts 48 hours). This way, if you reach Mythic League in all eight mines, you can get 120 red crystals once in two days for just eight battles.
 
Green chests will contain 50 red crystals. These chests are granted to three best players in the competition. Thus, it's possible to receive up to 400 red crystals in two days!
 
As mentioned above, the first season is a test season so numbers might change in the future.
Is there any news about the previously announced castle?
 
Late last year we told that we were working on a castle — a separate location, a kind of a base for a player. However, after a while we realized: before turning all efforts to a new feature, we should tweak other more important aspects of the game and improve mechanics that will affect it directly.
 
Even though the developers' focus was shifted in the following months, we continue to work on the castle. Moreover, soon we'll be ready to show you how it looks ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/031ea09e1c07eb0b540ed24a0f2588dd1c30aea3.png

You sent quite a few questions after the updated PvP system announcement, and we tried to answer as many of them as possible. But if you still have something to ask, go ahead! Write your questions in the comment section below and we'll make sure to answer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/43e96a2bff5fa59955ea7e186a302c29e3efa298.jpg

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/dbe8ffc72daa73e17ccd25e950a726a0fa408a72.png

Four new towers and two new spells entered the game.

Three of the towers are the event rewards for 15–69 level players:
 Mermaid's Tower: an epic tower that stuns creeps.
 Tornado Generator: a legendary flying tower that can curse enemies.
 Indestructible Idol: a legendary tower, used against underground creeps.

Note that now you can get these towers only through the event for 15–69 level players!

Another new tower and two new spells are intended for players of level 70 and above. You can find their shards in mythic chests as well as win this tower and the spells in the event for high-level players.
 Minigun: a mythic analog of Machinegun.
 Golden Dust Barrier: a mythic spell that increases tower toughness and repairs towers.
 Poisonous Swamp: a mythic spell that slows and poisons ground and underground creeps.

Pleasant news for all the players: four times as many spins for Stars in the new event! Now, for 100 Stars you get 2000 units of the event currency instead of 500! Learn more about the new event and rewards in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ee79e2e3779d82fa34e9b7042fbdab88338b2ba7.png

This update brings several exciting changes to the rewards!

From now on, the trophies you win can be more valuable! Previously, players received rewards that strictly adhered to certain levels. Now, they have a chance to get prizes of higher levels. The chances depend on the difficulty of the arena. The higher the difficulty, the higher the chance!

Let's consider some examples to see how the new reward algorithm is better for both new players and high-level veterans. But at first, we'd like to point out that the Expert difficulty level was renamed to epic, and epic, to legendary. So don't get confused ;)

For example, you can conquer a 10 level legendary arena and receive a reward, meant for level 15 or even 30! Isn’t that great? :)

Moreover, players of level 75 and above have a chance to hit the real jackpot! With a certain chance (that is determined by the difficulty of the arena), they can get a special battle. To earn the highest possible reward (two legendary chests) in such a battle, they simply need to complete six difficult levels instead of 20.

With the premium account, the jackpot is even tastier — four legendary chests for just one fight!

Also, the contents of epic and legendary chests became more valuable since we shifted the emphasis from resources to cards. Now, chests contain significantly more shards while the number of essences and Silver slightly dropped. This way, collecting towers and spells will be much easier :) The changes apply to the battle reward chests as well as the ones you see in the shop.

Another pleasant change refers to daily rewards. We substituted some specific cards for random cards of the same rarity. This way, the trophies you receive will be more diverse!

Premium days in the daily reward calendar have changed too. Days of premium account are no longer given once for three days. Instead, you will receive one day of premium three times (for new players, one day five times). Now, you can enjoy the advantages of the gift subscription several times per month instead of one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8f38d45b638f30a1ed6485477e2c2cf16148241e.png

Similar to league towers, certain towers of different rarity but the same mechanics can no longer be equipped at the same time. The following pairs are now mutually exclusive:
 Poison Shooter — Deadly Poison Shooter;
 Prime Cannon — Deadly Prime Cannon;
 Machinegun — Machinegun MK2;
 Frost Tower — Frost Guard;
 Accursed Tower — Accursed Bastion.

Please note: you can't hire new mythic Minigun together with Machinegun and Machinegun МК2, and the Golden Dust Barrier spell with Stone Shield.

Also, we continue to balance the game economics to keep the value of in-game currencies up to date. This time, the changes refer to Stars: in the mobile version, you can no longer receive them for watching ads. Moreover, some players were systematically finding ways to get around the restrictions and receive the unlimited number of the premium currency, gaining an unfair advantage over honest players.

Yet there are still a lot of other ways to get Stars for free: leveling up, entering the game regularly, and daily for PvP rating. You can also find Stars in chests around the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/cb77cd0cfcc19b2f7ebd4530b4a83effdfb65b3e.png

We also introduced a significant update to UI.

We moved game settings to the player's profile menu, under the Change Name button. Moreover, we removed the Facebook login icon because it’s also situated in the settings and isn't used that often anyway.

Please note that you can no longer invite Facebook users to the game. However, the change doesn't affect the system of friends!

Another small but nice change: the ship icon now shows the number of available upgrades.

We also tweaked the shop UI: offers with Stars and Silver in the shop are now separated into corresponding blocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png

Naturally, we introduced several fixes into the game too:
 The game no longer freezes when Glowworms appear.
 FPS no longer drops when Slothcat appears.
 Fixed inaccuracies in the description of Da’Ka, Highlander, Mage, Witch, and Quarrier.
 Vixen now affects Christmas tree and Snowball.
 Notifications on your unreviewed offers are no longer displayed near the shop icon.
 In the mobile version, a rare chest now has an ads timer in the shop, showing the time, left before the next free chest.

5 new towers added to the game!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5a8ee90c58382c0012180b22f26d644946742055.png

Defenders, merry Christmas and happy New Year! 

We hope that your mood is up and you are pleasantly waiting for the New Year to come. To make the atmosphere even more festive, we’ve prepared new mythic cards for you, which are made following the corresponding «snowy» theme. 

By the way, please note that the first «red» spell has appeared in Defenders 2! Don’t miss the chance to try it in action 

Greet the new mythic cards: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png⠀Christmas tree — a cheap tower that makes creeps confused. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png⠀Snowball — a flying tower that drops snowballs on the creeps. It deals heavy damage to them and slows all enemies it hits down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png⠀New Heroine, Lady Frost, increases the number of available mythic towers upgrades in battle.
We would like to kindly remind you that this content is made for high-level players, meaning that it gets unlocked only once you reach level 70. «Red» tower and new spell shards can be received by opening special boosters that are sold for red shards at the Shop. 

At the same time, Christmas event begins at the same time this update gets installed on our servers. Level 70+ players can earn red crystals and other high-level content for participating in it. Players below level 70 will have an opportunity to get valuable prizes that are especially useful on the early phase of the game! 

What is more, one more great surprise aways players of ALL levels: you will get a chance to receive a new legendary Heroine, — Snow Maiden, — by participating in the event. Thanks to her, almost all towers and their upgrades will cost less during the battle. The effect the Heroine provides does not apply only to mythic towers. Please note that you can get this Heroine only during the event at the current state of the game! 

You can even more details about the Christmas event in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d76439f3cbb34df745181c2ad68865c393bc2092.png

We’ve completely revised the reward system in Defenders 2, and now you will be receiving a lot more trophies for victories than before! 

Now you get the same prizes for victories in both PvE- and PvP-modes — chests with 5 random trophies. Among them, you can find Silver, Essences, Keys, Feeders, Runes, Tower or Spell cards or their shards. The type of the chests and the rarity of the rewards you get depends on your account level. Players without an active Premium subscription will receive 1 or 2 chests per victory, and the ones who own it will get from 2 to 4 chests per victory. This way, you will be getting from 5 to 20 trophies for each win instead of 1-2! 

Please note that you will receive chests for victories in mines, too. At the same time: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png captured PvP-mines will continue to bring resources (Silver or Essences); 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png you will still be getting league chests in league mines upon the end of the competition (new chests are given for in-between victories). 

Same as before, there are 4 available rewards on each of the arenas. You will be seeing them before the launch of the battle. Among the rewards, you may find chests that belong to one of the groups: rare, special, epic, and legendary. The quality of chests is determined by the player’s account level — the higher it is, the sweeter the reward! 

Reward renewal function has not changed. If you do not like the chest you are getting for the future fight, you can change the reward you receive for stars. At the same time, the new reward will be either of the same worth as the previous one, or of a better one (it can not be of a lesser worth than the old one). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/9b946bd7dcd4a7bc8cb459909d034f93780108b6.png

We’ve removed all old boosters from the game, excluding heroic and mythic ones, and replaced them with more relevant offers. Now you can purchase rare, special, epic, and legendary chests at the Shop. Level 70+ players can still purchase mythic boosters there. 

Rewarded ads now grant a rare chest instead of rare booster but only to players below level 70. Limited to one reward per hour with up to five rewards per day. 

We also changed rewards for the one-time purchase of 10 Boosters/Chests. 

What is more, we’ve prepared a pleasant bonus for you! For the first purchase of stars, you will get twice the premium currency! The offer applies to all boosters independently, that is, purchasing each of them can grant you a double sum of stars! 

Changes affected the Weekly Offers Shop too. In celebration of New Year and Christmas, we removed legendary All-Purpose Gears from it… and replaced them by mythic All-Purpose Gears — at the same price! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/16a8f1eaa4b1a338913edbbcb1327bf84e2df0c3.png

We’ve prepared a list of other changes that will make it a lot more comfortable to play Defenders 2. 

So, window mode has become available in the desktop version of the game! You can turn it on in the setting menu. The size of the window is fixed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png on UltraWide and SuperUltraWide displays, the size of the screen is determined by the height of the screen, 16:9 aspect ratio; 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png on 4K displays (Ultra HD), the window mode will run in 2K (2560x1440);

Improved multiple sale mode work. You can no longer sell locked cards. 

Improved Spider Nest effects. 

For the following towers, we’ve balanced out the Skill, Ascension & Ingenuity Runes effects: regular and league Sky Eye, regular and league Prime Injector, Detector and Locator, Engineering and Repairing Towers, regular and league Horrifying Tower, Frost Guard, Frost Tower, Shiny Crest, Colony of bats, Spider nest, and Aim Tower. Now, upon upgrading during the fight, their range gets increased by 5% instead of 20%. Aim tower will no longer make the range of the enlisted towers unreasonably wide. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/76bf220e08c206ebe32a7857ec1d066723a86d77.png

Defenders! You all know that we watch closely your feedback and comments. We were glad to see how much you liked the new towers and Heroes. It inspired us to create more fascinating and unusual mythic cards. The last cards were Halloween-themed. This time we fixed upon queer and yet so enchanting steampunk!

Introducing new mythic cards:
 Tower of Chaos — fires energy charges that pierce through the creeps, dealing AoE damage. Has a 30% chance of making the monsters confused for 5 seconds.
 Aim Tower — increases the range and damage dealt by nearby towers. Cannot be taken in battle alongside with Prime Injector.
 Tower of Order — slows the creeps down, dispels healing, speed up, and armor enhancement effects, making them immune to those effects for 5 seconds.
 Heroine Chronicle — increases the duration of mythic towers' effects.

Quick reminder: mythic cards are high-level content that is why it unlocks when your account reaches level 70. You can find previously added and new towers and Heroes in special boosters for red crystals.

Speaking of red crystals. It turned out Inventor stored up quite a few of them so he'd gladly exchange them for some Gear Wheels he needs so much!

A new event launches together with this Defenders 2 update
Participate in battles, collect mechanisms, use then to spin the Wheel of Fortune, and get random guaranteed prizes. Players of level 70 and above can earn crystals and other high-level content through the event. Players below level 70 can get other valuable prizes — ones that will be more useful at the early stage of the game. You can learn more about the event in the game itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7b2d8aec2e810acd0c6f18a1cc7ba0c2ed2e9796.png

We know how badly you wanted to see this feature in the game, so here it goes — at your request:

Now you can sell several cards at the same time!
To do so, click on a card in the collection menu and hold it until you see a suggestion to select other cards. Select all necessary cards and/or shards and press "Sell".

At the same time, you'll see prices displayed on the cards in the multiple sale mode. Press "Sell" and a confirm box will appear with the amount you'll gain.

Please note that:
 It's possible to sell a card with zero shards but for a corresponding price — 0 tokens.
 Runes are still sold by the piece.

You can leave the multiple sale menu the same way you leave the fuse menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/99e55bf2528d15da6c7188ecf4e5fec7bd0044b2.png

We added some more nice changes that players asked us about in social media and at the Steam forum. You’re going to love it 

Let's start with a pleasant trifle — the event window now has a "Skip chest animation" option. Tick the option to see the rewards right after you spin the wheel. Please note that the animation skipping works only for the "x5" button.

Before the battle starts, you can now see which towers and spells you have tasks for. Such cards have a green line saying "TASK" in the top right corner.

Chat no longer scrolls down automatically when you get a new message from another player or system notification. Autoscrolling will only happen in two cases: when you yourself send a new message or when you reenter the chat room.

And a cherry on top — now you can hire Trickster and Highlander at the same time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b8f55006be3c6066661a29907b334d6f4cdb72b1.png

This year we added loads of new content to the game and introduced many other significant changes that influenced both battle and economic balance one way or another. Unfortunately, it led to a devaluation of some truly rare items, making them look like a common and easily accessible content. This shouldn't work like that because, among other things, it has a great impact on players' interest. Defenders 2 is not only a tower defense but partly a collectible card game too. In CCGs, obtaining a rare and valuable card brings a special satisfaction and genuine joy.

Among such items are Legendary All-Purpose Gears and Spell Amplifiers. Basically, they are among the most valuable cards in the game — a kind of jokers that can substitute for any legendary tower or spell. Yet recently it became too easy to obtain them. We decided to restore their well-earned value, so we deleted them from the Hunt mode. From now on you can only find epic All-Purpose Gears and Spell Amplifiers at most. Additionally, Counter Boosters no longer contain feeders for legendary cards. In return, each booster is guaranteed to contain an epic amplifier.

Right now you can receive a legendary All-Purpose Gear as a one-time gift when purchasing 10 Counter Boosters. Moreover, you can win it in the new event!

Other changes in economics refer to tasks. The value of tasks has increased significantly after we introduced regular events to the game because they help the players to earn most of the event currency. At the same time, the price to update the tasks remained unchanged — calculated for common essences. Unfortunately, some players abused this feature to earn too much event currency in a short space of time. All this had a negative effect on the in-game balance in general.

That is why we are bringing in a new progressive cost of task updating. It won't affect average players but will cut short any possibilities of almost infinite and not quite fair farming of the event currency.

Essentially, from now on each subsequent update costs 30 stars more than the previous one — up to 195 stars. Yet, to make it possible for an average player to complete the usual number of tasks per day, the first update of the day costs 15 stars, just like it used to. We'd like to emphasize that when a new day starts, the cost is refreshed to its minimum, which is 15 stars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png

We also introduced several fixes to make Defenders 2 even more comfortable for you:
 Tasks are now available for league towers.
 Duelist grants the number of additional assaults that is displayed on his card.
 You can no longer insert runes that block the way of flying and underground creeps into Ghost tower.
 Banshee tower's description now displays the Lucky Rune effect.
 Creeps' cards now display the Defender effect.
 If you insert Skill Rune in Sky Eye or Colony of bats, the correct description will be displayed.
 The Monopolist and Who needs spells? achievements for Steam, Google, and Apple accounts are now granted when a player earns the third star in Feats instead of the first one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ce9fe0188b53ee5b1dbcddc37aa9a353c9d478fd.png

Defenders!

What a nightmare has begun in Praya! All Hallows' Eve is coming soon!

Various undead souls entered Praya, and they don’t want to go back to where they came from. What is more, they did not come empty-handed — they brought towers that can scare you to death with them!

Don’t rush into battle with the unwelcome guests. It will be more beneficial to recruit them, and leave the scary towers to yourself! They will be really useful in battle :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/630c2796e421d1ef51c817975f7b845dd2b891cf.png

Mythic towers and heroes have appeared in Defenders 2 — and we are eager to tell you how special they are!

They are not simply more powerful than the other towers, but their starting evolution is 6, meaning that they perform in battle differently right away!

Greet the first 5 mythic towers and… try not to fall back from fear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Colony of bats floats in the air. Shoots a colony of bats at the target. Bats block invisibility and deal all creeps around it damage. Does not block the creeps' way. But the special feature of this tower is that… it can move!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Spider nest spreads the web that slows all nearby creeps down and increases incoming damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Ghost tower summons ghosts every 2 seconds, but no more than 5. Sends them out fastly when creeps approach.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Pumpkin gun shoots pumpkins that deal damage and slow creeps down.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Banshee tower curses the creeps, making them receive more damage, has a 20% chance of leading creeps astray and forbidding them to use magic.

Four new Heroes provide bonuses to the mythic towers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Wendigo increases damage dealt by Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Trickster increases the rate of fire of Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats. Can not be hired when you’ve already hired Highlander. They do not get along well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Nosferatu increases the toughness of Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png Vixen increases Banshee tower's, Pumpkin gun's, and Spider nest's efficiency, as well as damage dealt by Ghost tower and Colony of bats.

Mythic cards are high-level content, so only level 70+ players have access to them. You can get new towers and heroes for opening special boosters, that are sold for red crystals. We kindly remind you that at the moment you can get red crystals only for participating in special events, available for level 70+ players only.

As with any other cards, mythic ones can be crafted. You will need the same number of shards as needed in order to make a legendary card — 100.

Speaking of evolution. You can evolve a mythic card only once — up to 7 stars. It does not matter if it is a hero or a tower card, you will need 50 red crystals for this upgrade.

Finishing off the topic of mythic cards, we want to answer a question we believe many want to ask now. Magic is magic for a reason. It must remain mysterious and unknowable, and for now, Primologists do not know how to make it mythic ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3cc8e160cdaced359a9e32ebb9e63e9cb3f905cf.png

A unique thematic event takes place in Defenders 2 for the first time! The perfidious government of Praya have caught poor aliens and imprisoned them in the secret base. Your task is to help the unlucky creatures get out of this protected area.

notes.title: Rune update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/41a7c4e91c826b453250d06423c2aaf66842da30.jpg

Mystics of Praya brought some great news! 
For many years in a row, they were unraveling the mysteries of the runes, studying their properties. In their search, they stumbled upon 2 wondrous discoveries, and they are eager to share them with you!

It occurred that you can enhance not only towers with the magic stones but also spells. Yet this discovery was not as amusing as the second one. Mystics found a way to merge similar runes, making them stronger. Today they will share the secrets of this process with you!

Friends, as you may have already understood, the brand new Prime World: Defenders 2 update is dedicated to runes and magic. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/74b8eab942a91441b8ea0f7ff74e8e7551bbf606.png
And here goes the full list of new features, which will take place in the game as soon as the patch is installed to our servers:

🔮 Focus Runed were added into the game. They are used for upgrading different entities which belong to the 1st and 4th cells in battles. Same as with towers, spells can now level up, and to do so, you don’t even need prime. Spells level up automatically with each rise of the battle’s difficulty, yet not higher than the value determined by runes. Focus runes can be won in ‘Assault’ mode, purchased at the shop in the ‘Random’ section, or found in the chests on the global map. The minimum rarity of the new runes is special (green). The effect of the two inserted runes is cumulative.

🔮 When you enter a level in a higher difficulty, the number of spells you can use in fight restores to the initial one.

🔮 A new function of merging runes has been added to the game. Now 4 similar runes can be merged into the same one but of a rarer quality.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/74b8eab942a91441b8ea0f7ff74e8e7551bbf606.png
In the nearest future, we will introduce one more update to you, which will add new content to the game and make Defenders 2 even more comfortable and interesting. 

Stay tuned!

✨ And 2 more small, but important announcements: ✨ 

1) As compensation for the long maintenance, we are giving away 50 stars to everyone who enters the game after this update!

2) We are truly sorry that iOS (mobile) version of the game is currently unavailable. Due to the tech issues on Apple servers, the update installation will take more time. We can't announce when exactly it will happen since the problem is not coming from our side.

notes.notes:

Greetings, friends!

After yesterday's update, some of you may have noticed that your PvP rating had been reduced. In some cases, the difference in today’s and yesterday’s rating was equal to up to 1000 points! We would like to explain to you why this happened.

At the end of the previous year, we wrote that PvP rating can be counted incorrectly in some cases. This lead to a situation where many players' rating became higher than their real one. The last update has fixed this bug, and now PvP rating points are being counted correctly for each and every one of you. In order to keep everything fair, we withdrew all the incorrect rating points from the game.

If your rating changed after yesterday's update, it did not become lower - it simply got back to its correct state!

There won't be any players with unreachable rating displayed in the Leaderboards anymore. Now literally anyone can climb their way to the top!

We wish you to have lots of fun in battles and glorious victories!
